added_lines: . the redwood community variety show will take place on wednesday, 25th november, at 7pm in redwood church, showcasing a variety of local talent. the full line - up will be announced in the coming weeks. admission is free, and tea and refresh ments will be served in redwood ns after the show. a raffle will also take place, with a ll proceeds going towards redwood church, redwood school and the samaritans. all are welcome to enjoy a great night of entertainment for all ages! stay warm keep moving – a four week walking group in borrisokane every wednesday from 4th november, starting at 10am, meeting at silver arch office. everyone is welcome to join for a relaxed walk, a warm up and a friendly chat! gaa notes: lotto 26-28-31-32, no winners. 3 match 3s: mary sherlock, martin hough (roden), brophy. next week’s jackpot: €5,900. congrats: to ken hogan, who led the harps to a first laois title in their history. social dancing: continues next friday at 9.30 to the music of noel briody. euro-millions: thanks to all who have sold tickets for the euro-millions and supported what is a vital fundraiser for the club. hopefully, we will have some winnings to distribute by the end of our term. sympathies: to the white and fogarty families on the death of john white, kildare, and to the kennedy family, graigue, rathcabbin, on the passing of martin. may they rest in peace. reflection jesus teaches us that love is at the heart of our faith. loving god means trusting and making him part of our daily lives. loving our neighbour means showing kindness, offering help, forgiving others and caring for those who feel forgotten. even small a cts of love can make a big difference. may we try each day to love god with all hearts and treat others as we would like to be treated. lorrha and dorrha

please note no liturgy this bank holiday monday reflection containers of diving love god of affection, devotion, passion, tenderness and all forms of love, this day we thank you for the myriad ways that we have been given a touch of your goodness.

we thank you for your many beneficent gestures: …love that draws us to friendship and fidelity, …love that leads us to kindness and compassion, …love that stirs in our flesh and dances in our bones, …love that lures us towards the sacred and serene, …love that calls us to new vision and growth, …love that soothes our heartaches and gentles our pain, …love that sees worth in each human being, …love that believes in us and whispers with hope, …love that sings in the seasons and sighs in the wind, …love that taps on the door of forgiveness, …love that longs for peace among all humankind, …love that surprises and fills us with awe, …love that sings praise for the face of earth’s beauty, …love that offers the hand of warm welcome, …love that respects those who won’t come too near , …love that urges us to take risks and have courage, …love that goes out to those from afar, …love that embraces the shadow in us, …love that sheds the old skin and welcomes the new, …love that ripens our souls for the final journey home.
source of love, we offer thanks for how you are abiding in all of these forms of love.
